name: Virtuo
summary:
Virtuo is a virtual reality training app designed to help musicians prepare for real performances with greater confidence.

Practice in realistic concert halls, examination rooms, and immersive performance environments while playing your own instrument through mixed reality passthrough. Experience the emotional pressure of performing in front of audiences and commissions, and build the focus needed for auditions, concerts, and exams.
